docs.text: Multimedia System (BIT477MS) study site by Er. Harish Thagunna.

docs.title: About this course site
docs.text: Multimedia System (BIT477MS) is an exam-focused study site covering all twelve units: topic notes, practice questions with model answers, and class slides.

docs.title: Author
docs.text: Prepared and maintained by Er. Harish Thagunna, instructor.

docs.title: Using the site
docs.text:
• Mark pages complete to track progress (stored only in your own browser).
  • Practice pages offer tap-to-answer MCQs, expand/collapse all and flashcards.
  • Use the revision planner to turn your exam date into a day-by-day plan.
  • Press / or s to search. Press the moon/sun icon to switch theme.
